# FluidUse attribution

Tokenizer.swift, Types.swift and TextManager.swift are derived from
[FluidInference/FluidUse](https://github.com/FluidInference/FluidUse), commit
`0230049c4e81f8de53ae1086b20cd9106c511105`, under Apache-2.0.
Original copyright and license terms remain with the upstream authors.
TextManager.swift was modified to accept explicit multimodal feature rows.
The native protocol and lifecycle bridge in Worker.swift is original MIT code.
Model weights are downloaded separately and are not included in the release.
